modules.title: Module 1 – Light‑Dependent Reactions
modules.description: Explore how plants capture light energy and convert it into chemical energy (ATP and NADPH).

topics.title: Structure and function of chlorophyll
topics.description: Identify chlorophyll molecules and explain how they absorb specific wavelengths of light.

topics.title: Photon capture in thylakoid membranes
topics.description: Describe the arrangement of photosystems I and II within the thylakoid membrane.

topics.title: Factors affecting light absorption
topics.description: Discuss how light intensity, wavelength, and pigment concentration influence energy capture.

subModules.title: Submodule 1.2 – Energy Conversion to ATP and NADPH

topics.title: Electron transport chain and proton gradient
topics.description: Explain how electrons move through the chain and generate a proton motive force.

topics.title: Photophosphorylation: ATP synthesis
topics.description: Detail the role of ATP synthase in converting the proton gradient into ATP.

topics.title: Formation of NADPH
topics.description: Outline the reduction of NADP+ to NADPH at photosystem I.

modules.title: Module 2 – Calvin Cycle and Photosynthetic Regulation
modules.description: Examine the carbon‑fixing reactions in the stroma and how environmental factors control photosynthesis rate.

topics.title: Carbon fixation and the role of Rubisco
topics.description: Describe how CO₂ is incorporated into ribulose‑1,5‑bisphosphate.

topics.title: Reduction phase: converting 3‑PGA to G3P
topics.description: Show how ATP and NADPH from the light reactions drive reduction.

topics.title: Regeneration of RuBP
topics.description: Explain the series of reactions that restore the CO₂ acceptor molecule.

topics.title: Impact of light intensity
topics.description: Discuss the light‑saturation point and photoinhibition.

topics.title: Effect of CO₂ concentration
topics.description: Explain how CO₂ availability influences the Calvin cycle rate.

topics.title: Temperature dependence
topics.description: Relate enzyme activity and membrane fluidity to temperature effects.
